aggregation: Complete log scores maximize over effective chunks; ROC points and counts are aggregate outputs. Cost usage sums selected successful tokens only over each model's own complete logs.
cost_reconstruction: Aggregate tokens exactly reproduce original costs because no selected request enters a long-context pricing tier. Rates are frozen at October 2, 2026.

ensemble_methods.aggregation: Maximum across chunks within model first, then mean score or mean percentile across the three complete models. Percentiles use average tied ranks / N within each model-behavior population before the complete-model intersection.
ensemble_methods.evaluation: Descriptive evaluation-sample results; no held-out calibration.
